title: Talk 3

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Kyoukaku? Xiá? Sure, your gallant swordsmen dedicated to lofty moral codes, you hear about them in Higashi's Chuushingura and Yan's wuxia tales, but I'm not the type at all. Those are vigilantes, going against the law with violence; and once you have law enforcement turning into vigilantes, or a vigilante with no choice but to join hands with the police, then everything will—Yeah, stuff's been messed up for a long, long time.
